cards.title: Phase B — Kelly sizing replaces band sizing
cards.dates: Sep 8 (Tue) — Kelly-window start · window reads Oct 8
cards.gate: Ships Tue Sep 8 on the Sep 1 λ̂ refit (7 days old — within the biweekly envelope); the scheduled Sep 15 + Oct 1 refits land mid-window as system-under-test refreshes, not ad hoc changes
cards.note: Port oracle3 ModelInformedSizer semantics (Apache-2.0): edge = bucket-λ-adjusted premium, Kelly ≤ 0.15×bankroll, confidence-scaled. Replaces heuristic band multipliers; paper caps kept. Input (audited 2026-08-31): drafts/octagon-audit.md — MIT reference impl for executable-quote Kelly (edge vs ask, not midpoint), liquidity haircut, per-category concentration + drawdown gates; calibrate to Polymarket, don't copy Kalshi defaults. Ref (awesome-options audit 2026-09-01): Thorp (2006) 'Kelly Criterion in Blackjack, Sports Betting, and the Stock Market' — canonical binary-bet fractional-Kelly treatment; read before the Kelly ship (2026-09-08). Predicted impact (2026-09-01, calibration-based): +$5–25/day (+3–15% of ~$165/day window) — long-shot <0.20 band up-sized 3–6x (z=4.14 edge), 0.80+ favorite band → ~0 trades (significant −8.7pp), executable-quote edge ~1c/trade. FALSIFIABLE TARGETS: (1) long-shot band share of realized PnL rises 3–6x vs pre-Kelly 48d window; (2) 0.80+ band trades ≈ 0; (3) no increase in max drawdown. PULLED FORWARD 2026-09-05 (approved): ships Tue Sep 8 on the Sep 1 λ̂ refit (in-envelope); Sep 15 + Oct 1 refits land mid-window as scheduled system refreshes. COMPRESSED: build + review + user approval by Sep 8. Pre-Kelly clean baseline = Sep 4–8 (4 trading days) only. CAVEAT: the +$5–25/day predicted impact was scaled off a ~$165/day window that does NOT match realized data (≈ −$10/day pre-fix) — re-pre-register expected impact on the 4 clean baseline days before ship; window-end reads Oct 8.

cards.title: Pre-commit: Oct 8 Kelly-window gate + concept menu (binding)
cards.effort: decision point only — no code before it
cards.dates: Opened 2026-09-05 · reads 2026-10-08 (Kelly window Sep 8–Oct 8, pulled forward)
cards.note: BINDING at window close: (1) clean-regime daily expectancy > $0 at current caps; (2) long-shot <0.20 band share of realized PnL 3–6× pre-Kelly share (phase-b falsifiable target); (3) 0.80+ favorite band ≈ 0 trades; (4) no max-drawdown increase vs pre-Kelly clean baseline; (5) 0.40–0.60 mid-band (the −$434 black hole, confirmed 2026-09-05 exit-recovery analysis: entries primary, exits secondary — hold-to-24h still negative) must shrink toward ~0 trades / ~$0 PnL. ALL PASS → unlock the overlay roadmap (ML-1 build, Phase C arb build, GDELT wiring), production-capital sizing, goal-ladder + funding-schedule re-baseline. EXPECTANCY ≤ 0 → stop adding layers; run the concept menu: (a) band-conditional fade-whale test, (b) calibration-only entries, (c) arb-only, (d) ML on market features (NOT whale copies); decide whether the copy lane survives or the bot re-architects around the corrections (premium/timing/category). NO rule/sizing/live-lane changes before the window closes — measurement/observability fixes only (scheduled λ̂ refits Sep 15 + Oct 1 excepted: system-under-test, not changes). Companion: regime-cleanliness-baseline. Observability gap to close pre-window: post-exit token price at +1h/+6h/+24h per early exit (only 211/984 testable today).
